text_en: It is too dark to see clearly.
It would be best to turn on the <ms=250><sfx=question_bell><color=#D8E88F>mood lamp</color>.
text_ja: <ms=250><sfx=question_bell><color=#D8E88F>ムードライト</color>をつけたほうがよさそうだ。

text_en: What are you doing over there?
text_ja: そこで何をしているんですか？

text_en: You were so loud, you woke me up.
text_ja: うるさくて、起きちゃったじゃないですか。

text_en: Oh... what is this? Were you trying to escape?
text_ja: あ……何ですか。逃げようとしていたんですか？

text_en: No.<ms=300> You.<ms=300> Cannot.<ms=300> You need proper rest at night.
text_ja: だ<ms=300>・め<ms=300>・で<ms=300>・す。夜はきちんと休まないと。

text_ko: 여기에는 쓸 수 없을 것 같다.
text_en: I do not think I can use this here.
text_ja: ここでは使えそうにない。

text_ko: 지금은 할 수 있는 게 없어 보인다.
text_en: There does not seem to be anything I can do right now.
text_ja: 今はできることがなさそうだ。

text_en: I shone the flashlight over it.
<sfx=heart_drop><shake><color=#FF5A5A>I feel more anxious.</color> <ms=500><color=#FFD95A>The composure I was clinging to</color> begins to waver.
text_ja: <sfx=heart_drop><shake><color=#FF5A5A>気持ちが焦り始めた。</color> <ms=500><color=#FFD95A>どうにか保っていた平静</color>が揺らいだ。

text_en: <sfx=heal><color=#D8E88F>I feel much better.</color> <ms=500><color=#FFD95A>I regain my lost composure.</color>
text_ja: <sfx=heal><color=#D8E88F>気分がずいぶん楽になった。</color> <ms=500><color=#FFD95A>乱れていた平静</color>を取り戻した。
